What it does: Vendored pipeline from ajayck007/myuni-sentiment-poc-melisa-v1. Per-modality models with late fusion.
Key Components: Text: RoBERTa sentiment. Image/Video frames: SigLIP zero-shot visual sentiment (positive/neutral/negative). Audio: Whisper ASR → RoBERTa sentiment on transcript. Late fusion: confidence-weighted average of modalities.
Remarks: Frame-level scoring is independent (no temporal model). Uses @spaces.GPU decorator for SigLIP forward — crashes on CPU-only Spaces. Fixed by monkey-patching spaces.GPU to no-op.
Improvement in Next Iteration: Replace the 3-class output with 8-emotion distribution. Add temporal awareness across frames. Move from heuristic fusion to LLM-based synthesis.

What it does: Custom multimodal pipeline using Qwen2.5-VLM-3B-Instruct. Single unified model processes text + image + video together.
Key Components: Qwen VLM generates structured JSON with content/tone/intent/harm assessment. Fallback to mock mode (QWEN_MOCK=1) for local testing without GPU.
Output Format: Full JSON: execution_time_seconds / understanding / risk / action / emotion_analysis
Remarks: Required GPU for real inference; mock mode for local dev. Gradio UI had side-by-side comparison with Melisa POC. Heavy on GPU for video/image processing.
Improvement in Next Iteration: Replace GPU-dependent VLM with CPU-friendly per-frame CNN + temporal aggregation. Keep the same JSON output format for compatibility.

What it does: New 8-emotion pipeline with temporal awareness. Per-frame CNN (ResNet-18/FER2013) → temporal weighted average.
Key Components: Video frames: ResNet-18 CNN (random weights) → 8 Plutchik emotions. Temporal aggregation: exponential-decay weighted average across frame sequence. Caption: RoBERTa sentiment → heuristic mapping to 8 emotions. Audio transcript: OpenRouter emotion analysis (or RoBERTa fallback). Late fusion: confidence-weighted fusion of 8-emotion distributions.
Output Format: Same JSON format as Qwen (execution_time_seconds / understanding / risk / action / emotion_analysis)
Remarks: ResNet-18 had pretrained=False with no checkpoint loaded → random output. EmotionNet failed on numpy arrays (expected PIL Image) — fixed later. Audio analysis fails on video-only files (no audio stream) — expected. Runs on CPU — no GPU required.
Improvement in Next Iteration: Replace the random ResNet-18 CNN with a real pretrained model. Use SigLIP zero-shot instead of CNN for meaningful per-frame emotions.

What it does: SigLIP replaces random ResNet-18. Added image branch support.
Key Components: Video frames: SigLIP zero-shot 8-emotion classification per frame. Temporal aggregation: exponential-decay weighted average. Image branch: single image treated as 1-frame video. Caption + audio: same as before. Late fusion: same confidence-weighted fusion.
Remarks: SigLIP is pretrained and general-purpose — no face detection needed. Frame emotions are meaningful (non-uniform). Image inputs now processed (previously ignored). Audio still fails on video-only files — non-critical. Runs on CPU.
Improvement in Next Iteration: Move from mathematical fusion (weighted average) to LLM-based synthesis. Let the LLM see per-frame emotions with timestamps + audio + text together for richer context understanding.

What it does: Per-frame SigLIP emotions + timestamps + audio transcript + caption → sent to LLM for final synthesis.
Key Components: Video: extract frames at sample_fps with timestamps → SigLIP 8-emotion per frame. Audio: Faster-Whisper → transcript. LLM (OpenRouter GPT-4o-mini) receives full context: frame emotions with timestamps + audio + caption. LLM returns synthesized 8-emotion distribution with rationale.
Output Format: Same JSON format + frame_timestamps array for transparency
Remarks: Max 20 frames sent to LLM to keep prompt size manageable. Fallback when no API key: averages frame emotions or uses text heuristic. LLM can detect temporal dynamics (emotion shifts across frames) and cross-modal disagreement. More expensive due to LLM API calls.
Improvement in Next Iteration: Switch from OpenRouter to Kimi (Moonshot AI) for potentially better Chinese/English bilingual support and different pricing.

What it does: Same architecture as iteration 5 but using Kimi (Moonshot AI) API directly instead of OpenRouter.
Key Components: Same per-frame SigLIP + timestamp extraction. Same Faster-Whisper audio. Kimi API endpoint: https://api.moonshot.cn/v1/chat/completions. Model: kimi-k2-5. Same prompt engineering for 8-emotion JSON output.
Remarks: Kimi may offer better bilingual support and different pricing vs OpenRouter. API key configured via KIMI_API_KEY env var or hardcoded placeholder. Fallback behavior identical when no API key. All previous remarks about frame capping and temporal dynamics still apply.
Improvement in Next Iteration: Future: Add face detection + cropping before SigLIP for better emotion accuracy on facial expressions. Fine-tune emotion prompts per domain. Add support for real-time streaming video analysis.
